epsilon_E.definition: Maximum absolute independent E_dir difference across output-sampling and the listed refinement kinds; engineering error estimate, not a confidence interval.
epsilon_E.convergence_tolerance_definition: V9 E_dir comparison pass threshold max(0.01 um, 1% of reference); this is separate from epsilon_num and the S_E denominator floor.

old_new_significance.epsilon_floor_source: Inherited predeclared V8 precision floor: config/clearance_v8_config.json health_result.epsilon_E_um=0.0001 um; same value is retained in GPTOrder/spindle_v9_tai_bearing_plan/baseline_snapshot/parameters_v8_calibrated.json. This is not the V9 E_dir convergence acceptance tolerance.
old_new_significance.epsilon_num_definition: Each epsilon_num is only the maximum measured independent E_dir difference for that case; no acceptance threshold is inserted into epsilon_num.
old_new_significance.epsilon_definition: S_E=|E_new-E_old|/(epsilon_num_old+epsilon_num_new+0.0001 um). The fixed 0.0001 um floor is predeclared from the inherited V8 precision baseline.
